purpose: ExecRunner runs the checker with the capsule's stock python3 in isolated mode.
title: ExecRunner

purpose: L2Bridge runs an Action through the L2 executor. The action is first decoded by L2's strict decoder, so anything L3 emits is held to the frozen schema.
title: L2Bridge

purpose: FakeCaller serves fixtures from testdata/cu/mcp/fake_*.json (no sockets).
title: FakeCaller

purpose: HTTPCaller dials a capsule forwarder with JSON-RPC tools/call. Any transport failure is E_MCP_UNAVAILABLE. Never exercised by tests (no sockets).
title: HTTPCaller

purpose: MockGUI is a test-only Executor for --mock-gui: it records nothing and has no verifier, so it reports UNVERIFIED and must never be wired in production.
title: MockGUI

purpose: Unwired refuses every GUI action until the L2 exec is bound.
title: Unwired

purpose: newStep builds a complete vqa.act-step/v1 for an action L3 did not actuate itself: frame fields are zero-valued and input_sha256 follows L2's formula (sha256(action_sha256 \n digest \n canonical(located))) over the hash of the call params, so it is never the empty-string hash.
title: newStep

purpose: CAS is a content-addressed store for untrusted server bytes.
title: CAS

purpose: Put stores b and returns (ref, sha). Over MaxContent -> rc 6, nothing written.
title: CAS.Put

purpose: Dispatcher is the Executor for op mcp_call; every other op is delegated to GUI (L2 exec). Verification never uses the MCP rc: only Verifier evidence.
title: Dispatcher

purpose: guardGodotCall applies GuardGodotProject at admission to every godot-beckett call that names a project_path; a write/irrev call must name one.
title: Dispatcher.guardGodotCall

purpose: judge decides the verdict from the disjoint evidence only.
title: Dispatcher.judge

purpose: scriptOf recovers the script text from the {"code": ...} call arguments.
title: scriptOf

purpose: EditorParams are the closed parameters of the editor operations.
title: EditorParams

purpose: Plan is the lowering of an editor op: a GUI action list or a bpy script.
title: Plan

purpose: PlanEditorOp lowers one editor operation. Blender gizmo drag and the Godot editor ops are GUI plans; workspace switch / area split are bpy scripts.
title: PlanEditorOp

purpose: RcOf maps an error to the shared R4 table (never 1).
title: RcOf

purpose: StopOf returns the short stop reason of a table error.
title: StopOf

purpose: CheckEndpoint admits only the capsule forwarder 127.0.0.1:19876+n (n 0..7).
title: CheckEndpoint

purpose: CheckEnvelope fails when any 12-byte window of server content appears in the envelope (server bytes must live only in CAS).
title: CheckEnvelope

purpose: GuardGodotProject allows only a clean absolute path inside the capsule scratch dir and never under an OZ root.
title: GuardGodotProject

purpose: ScanScript statically denies unsafe execute_blender_code / python_exec scripts: imports are an allowlist (bpy, math, mathutils), dynamic-code and attribute-reflection names are denied, and open( is admitted only as a call with exactly two literal arguments (path, mode) whose path is canonical and un
title: ScanScript

purpose: codeOnly drops # comments string-aware (a '#' inside a literal is kept and cannot hide the rest of its line) and refuses backslash continuations and unterminated literals, so one physical line is one logical line for the scan. It also returns every literal's raw body, and refuses any byte >= 0x80 ou
title: codeOnly

purpose: inOut reports whether a literal path is canonical, absolute and under outDir.
title: inOut

purpose: literalPrefix returns the string-prefix letters (r, b, f, u) right before a quote.
title: literalPrefix

purpose: LoadRegistry decodes strictly (unknown field / bad enum -> rc 2).
title: LoadRegistry

purpose: build converts one tool call into exactly one vqa.action/v1.
title: Server.build

purpose: strictFields rejects keys outside the tool's own property list, then decodes.
title: strictFields

purpose: Sha256 is the action digest. It is L2's: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the action as decoded by action.DecodeAction, so AJSON keys agree across L2/L3. An action L2 cannot decode has no digest ("").
title: Action.Sha256

purpose: Executor runs one action. Domain refusals are reported in Outcome.Step.Rc (nil error); error is reserved for I/O or programming faults.
title: Executor

purpose: Outcome is what one Execute produces.
title: Outcome

purpose: Check returns TestFake only for OS_CU_TEST=1 (no other variable is read) and Prod only when every production condition holds, tested in the order capsule, display, iso so a host never reaches the X server.
title: Check

purpose: IsoReader reads _OPENNEWTON_ISOLATION_ID from the root window of display.
title: IsoReader

purpose: Mode is the outcome of Check; the zero value means refused.
title: Mode

purpose: Args are the production inputs of a CU binary.
title: Args

purpose: Build is the single production door: Check first (zero events on refusal), then XTestActuator + Snapper observer. The returned func releases everything.
title: Build

purpose: Deps are the effects behind Build; tests inject fakes, Real() is production.
title: Deps

purpose: Real is the production dependency set.
title: Real

purpose: XIso is the real IsoReader: a root-window GetProperty over the capsule X server.
title: XIso

purpose: Code maps a table name to its rc; unknown names map to Gate (5).
title: Code

purpose: Error carries a table name; its exit code is table[Name].
title: Error

purpose: Of maps any error to an rc: nil -> 0, *Error -> table, anything else -> 2 (E_IO).
title: Of

purpose: Table returns a copy of the name -> rc table.
title: Table
